title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, concrete agent/tool-calling examples for Python and TypeScript, and accompanying docs site updates. Motivation: make it easy for engineers to prototype RAG agents with Redwood by providing end-to-end quickstarts (dataset ingestion -> retriever config -> agent orchestration -> tool calling) and canonical examples using the SDKs. This PR includes: 1) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md with two opinionated templates (faq-bot and assistant-with-tools) and guidance for retrieval config and cache sizing; 2) redwood-examples/rag/{python,ts} agent examples demonstrating tool registration, function calling, streaming responses, and KV-cache-friendly prompt patterns; 3) docs site sidebar and nav updates so quickstarts appear under "Guides -> Agents & RAG"; 4) small SDK helper added to redwood-sdk-python (examples/helpers/rag_helper.py) and a parallel TS helper; 5) CI integration tests that smoke the quickstarts in a short-lived local mode; 6) checklist for security review and docs review. Implementation notes: kept code examples minimal and copy-paste ready, provided environment variable docs (REDBWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_RETRIEVER_URL), and linked to model recommendations in the model catalog. Testing: local smoke tests passed in CI after one flaky test (integration/file-indexer) was fixed by increasing wait/retry. Related Linear: ENG-12890, PM-7421. See review conversation for minor follow-ups (doc wording and a small API helper rename).
